description.en: A curated index of the PerryLink DeepSeek Harness plugin family: security, sessions, research, compliance checkers, and domain tools.
description.zh: PerryLink DeepSeek Harness 插件族策展索引：安全、会话、研究、合规核查器与领域工具。

description.en: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent or the local non-generative Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1 decision model decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and full session-log audit.
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动复核：只读复核子代理在审批应答链上给出允许/拒绝，失败即拒，全过程留痕在会话日志里。

description.en: Declarative Claude Code-style permission rules plus a Codex-style process-level network policy for DeepSeek Harness: ordered allow/deny/ask rules with tool-name, argument (glob/regex), workspace-path, and network-target (domain/ip/port/scheme) matching on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, a built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy governing shell subprocess traffic, three network modes mapped onto the official sandbox presets, full session-log audit, HMR rule reload, and a settings page with a rule editor, block counters, and recent interception lists.
description.zh: 声明式、有序的允许/拒绝/询问权限规则：匹配工具名、参数（glob/正则）、工作区路径与网络目标（域名/IP/端口/协议），并带进程级网络策略。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — a capability seam (ctx.memory service + local SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection), not another memory warehouse
description.zh: 有界、分层、审批门控、可审计的跨会话记忆：一条能力接缝（ctx.memory 服务 + 本地 SQLite provider + memory 工具 + 冻结快照注入），不是又一个记忆仓库。

description.en: Unified DSH checkpoints: session + workspace + config three-state snapshots with one-shot rollback — /checkpoint and /rewind commands, a checkpoint tool, automatic interval snapshots, a Settings page timeline with pairwise diffs, and seed-replay session rollback via the official sessions.create API
description.zh: 统一的 DSH 检查点：会话/工作区/配置三态快照，一条命令 /checkpoint 与 /rewind 回滚，附 checkpoint 工具、定时自动快照、带两两差异的设置页时间线与种子重放式会话恢复。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: edge-first arrows with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, workspace-scoped recall, and fully configurable keys — plus sliding-context awareness (compaction summaries join recall/search, a compaction notice with one-click /compact fill) layered on the ordinary composer draft only.
description.zh: Web 输入框的终端式历史：边缘优先的方向键与草稿/光标精确还原、浏览器本地持久化、Ctrl+R 反向搜索、工作区召回与滑动上下文感知。

description.en: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning, and verification for DeepSeek Harness: a ctx.dataQuality capability seam (Service Definition / local Provider / tool Consumers) with data_profile, data_clean, and data_verify model tools, a frozen cross-plugin verifyCitations contract, durable reports in a storage domain, and data-quality/* session events on hosts that support them.
description.zh: 确定性的数据画像、清洗与校验：DAMA 记分卡、内容哈希去重、指标期望与漂移检查。

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness: a content-addressed evidence ledger (claim — snapshot binding, tamper-evident) plus versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory. Retrieval orchestration reuses the official ctx.web / ctx.jobs seams — no deep-research loop.
description.zh: 带完整性的研究报告：报告与证据一一关联，内容哈希封住来源目录。

description.en: Local document knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: library_add/remove/list, hybrid semantic+keyword library_search with diversity re-ranking, relevance filtering and lost-in-the-middle avoidance, citation-aware injection, library_cite_check and library_diagnose —SQLite-backed index via the storage domain, local embedding, zero model downloads
description.zh: 本地文档知识库：library_add/remove/list，语义加关键词的混合检索 library_search（带多样性重排与防"中间遗忘"）、引用感知注入、library_cite_check 与 library_diagnose，SQLite 索引与本地嵌入，不下载模型。

description.en: GitHub PRs, reviews, issues and CI for DeepSeek Harness: approval-gated write tools, a CI composite action, a polling review bot and a status-check gate.
description.zh: GitHub 集成：PR/issue/仓库/文件工具、评审与 CI 检查，每次写入都需人工审批，token 从不进日志。

description.en: PII masking middleware for DeepSeek Harness: regex-detect and replace phones, emails, ID cards, bank cards, keys, and (opt-in) IPs with placeholders before they reach the model, keep the restore table host-side (memory plus a controlled storage domain, never the session log) with the /mask restore command and the exported RestoreStore seam, and expose /mask status and the mask_test tool. Name and address recognition needs an external NER recognizer, which this pure-host form does not bundle: mode "regex+ner" and the person/address entities fail loudly at load. The phone and ID-card detectors match mainland-China formats only.
description.zh: PII 脱敏中间件：手机号、邮箱、身份证、银行卡与密钥在到达模型前变成占位符，宿主侧还原表保证可逆，明文不进会话日志。

description.en: Check an aquaculture input register for completeness and withdrawal-period date arithmetic — you get a list of which row, which column, and what to fix; the verdict stays with the reviewer.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录核对（按投入品用量、休药期与起捕间隔核对记录自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Check every retained-sample row against the four required elements, the 125-gram floor, the 48-hour window, and leftover template placeholders — report only what the ledger can prove, leave the verdict to the reviewer.
description.zh: 核对食堂留样台账：四要素是否齐全、留样量是否达 125 克、是否冷藏满 48 小时、是否残留模板占位符。

description.en: Prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak detection with allow/ask/block interception for DeepSeek Harness: an Aho-Corasick pattern engine and heuristics ported from the Prompt-Injection-Payloads, Jailbreak-Detector, and Secret-Key-Leaker-Detect assets, gating user messages on agent/pre-step, tool arguments on tools/pre-execute, and tool results on tools/post-execute, with sanitized defend/* session audit events, a defend_report tool, and a /defend command.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的提示注入、越狱与密钥泄漏防御：Aho-Corasick 检测配允许/询问/阻断拦截、脱敏审计事件，以及递归删除的执行前闸门。

description.en: Turn one emergency drill script into a difference list — which row, which column, what is off, and how to fix it.
description.zh: 应急演练脚本核对（按阶段、响应分级、指挥与资源要素核对脚本齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Check an emergency plan's element completeness clause by clause, and locate every difference by page or line — the judgement stays with the reviewer.
description.zh: 应急预案要素齐备性与条款级页码定位（依据 GB/T 29639-2020 等公开文件，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: 线损电量拆分与考核表核对（依据公开的线损计算口径，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 线损电量拆分与考核表核对（依据公开的线损计算口径，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: 电力工作票要素齐备性与签发许可顺序核对（依据现行电力安全工作规程，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 电力工作票要素齐备性与签发许可顺序核对（依据现行电力安全工作规程，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Turn public URLs into a local, reviewable timeline with separated clocks, date conflicts, gaps, and a four-file report. No website, no people search, no true/false verdict.
description.zh: 把公开 URL 变成本地可复核的时间线：分离时间角色、日期冲突、缺口、覆盖和四件套报告。不建站、不查人、不裁决真假。

description.en: Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness sessions: a dedicated git mirror of the session store, append-only three-way merge with keep-both + fork conflict resolution, /sync command, sync_pull/sync_push/sync_status tools, and configurable auto push/pull
description.zh: 会话日志同步：把会话记录推/拉到远端存储，自动推拉可配置。

description.en: Does the source actually support the claim as written?
description.zh: 来源原文是否真的支持这条断言？逐字节、确定性、可复算：逐字片段、数字、带标签的数值、否定与限定。转述按 insufficient 处理，绝不报“支持”。

description.en: REP v1 — the shared Research Evidence Protocol for the DSH research plugin family.
description.zh: REP v1——DSH 科研插件家族的共享证据协议。一套协议、一个存储、一个校验器：每个科研插件说同一种证据语言，任何人 30 秒内可复算它声称的结论。

description.en: One-command research suite for DeepSeek Harness: installs the core evidence, verification, systematic-review and report plugins as one bundle layer, and adds a research_doctor health check for the REP store.
description.zh: 一条命令装齐 12 个科研插件，并挂载 research_doctor：只读检查 REP 根目录、已挂载服务、日志与最新封印记录。

description.en: Verify that a citation exists and that its metadata is right, for DeepSeek Harness: DOI / PMID / arXiv / BibTeX resolution through Crossref, PubMed and arXiv, field-by-field metadata comparison, version/duplicate/retraction observations, content-addressed response snapshots and a REP v1 evidence record. not_found is reported as skipped, never as fabrication.
description.zh: 核验一条引用确实存在——并核验它的元数据是否正确。DOI / PMID / arXiv / BibTeX → 数据源自己的回答、逐字段核对、内容寻址的快照与 REP 证据记录。

description.en: Data-management-plan tooling for DeepSeek Harness: a ten-section scaffold with prompts, completeness/consistency checks (datasets, personal data, open-sharing conflicts, retention minimum, backup, repository/license/DOI, contact), Markdown/JSON/SARIF export. Checks are internal consistency checks, not funder-template certification; no network, no file writes.
description.zh: 一份说得清数据放在哪里、谁能动、资助结束后如何处置的数据管理计划。十节脚手架，每节带提示语；检查个人数据与开放共享、最短保存期、备份、仓库/许可证/DOI。

description.en: Turn one essay rubric sheet into a point-by-point list of what is inconsistent — which row, which field, what is missing, and how to fix it.
description.zh: 作文量表评分核对（按评分项、原文定位与分值算术核对评分自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Research plugin for Chinese public mutual funds on DeepSeek Harness: collects fund data from public sources (Tiantian Fund / Eastmoney), computes deterministic metrics (manager profile, holdings penetration, style attribution, performance decomposition), and seals versioned Markdown research reports whose every key number traces back to a hashed source snapshot. Research only — no trading, no investment advice.
description.zh: 基金研究：分析基金的收益、持仓与业绩归因。

description.en: 中文基金申请书检查（DeepSeek Harness）：19 项起步清单（项目名称/摘要/科学问题属性 A-D/立项依据/目标/内容/方案/技术路线/创新/可行性/基础/条件/团队/预算/预算说明/伦理/数据共享/限项/参考文献），预算算术与结构校验（设备费/业务费/劳务费/间接费用，合计一致性），申请材料包扫描（申请书/预算表/伦理/承诺书/简历/附件），输出 JSON/Markdown 与 REP 证据。关键词清单，不是评审结论。
description.zh: 投稿/申报前：本子的检查清单是否齐、预算算术是否对、材料包是否真的打包了？面向中文基金申请书的 19 项结构/属性/声明检查、预算算术与材料包扫描。

description.en: Image integrity checks for DeepSeek Harness: zero-dependency 8-bit PNG decoding (grey/RGB/RGBA) with mean-threshold block fingerprints and NCC confirmation to find duplicated or mirrored regions inside one figure or shared between two figures, plus REP evidence and Markdown/SARIF reports. Finds reused pixels, not manipulation intent; JPEG is out of scope in v0.1.
description.zh: 这张子图是不是被复用了——原地重复，还是从另一张图镜像粘贴过来？零依赖 PNG 解码、带 NCC 确认的均值阈值块指纹、重复/镜像区域报告与 SARIF。

description.en: Industry and company research domain pack for DeepSeek Harness: methodology skills, an industry-chain structure model (industry_map), public-source policy/news tracking over ctx.web (industry_track), company scan cards (company_scan), and auditable research reports with an optional ctx.researchReport sealing bridge and a builtin Markdown fallback (industry_report). Research only — not investment advice.
description.zh: 行业研究工具箱：结构化的公司与行业专题，附来源留档与可审计的研究轨迹。

description.en: Ethics-application checklist for DeepSeek Harness: 18-item keyword checklist (title, PI, purpose, design, participants, recruitment, consent, assent, risks, benefits, confidentiality, vulnerable groups, compensation, conflicts, retention, dissemination, animal ethics, biosafety), an advisory risk level with required safeguards from structured flags, Markdown/SARIF export and REP evidence. Not an IRB decision and not legal advice.
description.zh: 赶在伦理委员会之前把申请材料准备好——并知道哪些核心陈述还缺着。18 项关键词清单、建议性风险等级与对应保障措施，可导出 Markdown + SARIF。

description.en: Close the arithmetic and the loop on a competency-gap and development-plan register in one call — differences only, no verdicts.
description.zh: 能力差距与培养计划核对（按能力等级差、培养措施与完成期限核对台账闭环，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Literature harvesting for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic multi-source search (OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Europe PMC), open-access link resolution through Unpaywall, quota + subtopic sufficiency checks with explicit gaps, and a bounded harvest loop whose run record lands in REP. No LLM, no scraping, no CNKI bypass.
description.zh: 多源文献收割：OpenAlex / Crossref / arXiv / Europe PMC 一次检索，Unpaywall 解析开放获取，报告充分性缺口，并把本轮运行写成 REP 证据记录。

description.en: Literature watch for DeepSeek Harness: save named Crossref bibliographic queries with time windows, run them against Crossref with a bounded client, keep a seen-DOI store so repeated runs return only genuinely new items, and render a Markdown digest plus SARIF. A watch reports new DOIs in a search window, not relevance or quality.
description.zh: 这次检索相比上次新增了什么——而且只报新增。保存带时间窗口的 Crossref 检索；用已见 DOI 库保证重复运行只返回真正新增的条目。

description.en: Meta-analysis arithmetic for DeepSeek Harness: effect-size conversions (OR/RR/d/r/SMD, SE from CI) with named formulas, fixed-effect and DerSimonian-Laird random-effects pooling, Q/df/p, I2, tau2, forest-plot data, Markdown/SARIF reports and a light Egger test for k >= 10. Local, dependency-free, reproducible from the inputs.
description.zh: 把效应量合并起来——每一步算术都能逐行核对。效应量换算、固定效应与 DerSimonian–Laird 随机效应合并、Q / I² / τ²、森林图数据与轻量 Egger 检验。

description.en: 国家自然科学基金申请书形式审查与匿名化提示（依据《国家自然科学基金条例》与申请人导入的当年指南，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 国家自然科学基金申请书形式审查与匿名化提示（依据《国家自然科学基金条例》与申请人导入的当年指南，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: 试卷解析结构核对（按题型、答案、分值与 yotta 标识核对试卷结构自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 试卷解析结构核对（按题型、答案、分值与 yotta 标识核对试卷结构自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: 政策专报要素核对（按观点、依据、出处与建议核对专报齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 政策专报要素核对（按观点、依据、出处与建议核对专报齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Reproducibility evidence for DeepSeek Harness: a bounded read-only scan records the git commit and dirty state, dependency lockfiles, environment pins, input-data hashes, figures, notebooks, explicit seeds and runnable commands, derives gap severities and a reproducible/partial/not_reproducible level, compares a recorded manifest against the current tree for drift, and renders a report card with Markdown and SARIF.
description.zh: 别人能复现这项分析吗——以及从你记录至今，有没有东西发生漂移？有界只读扫描记录 commit、lockfile、环境、数据哈希、图表、seed 与运行命令。

description.en: Seven research SOP skills for DeepSeek Harness: literature review, citation audit, claim/evidence audit, manuscript preflight, reviewer response, reproducibility audit and data-management planning. Each skill ends in a REP record or an explicit verdict, never in prose alone.
description.zh: 七个科研 SOP 技能：文献综述、引文审计、断言/证据审计、投稿前检查、审稿回复、可复现性审计与数据管理计划；每个技能都以记录或明确结论收尾。

description.en: Retraction and correction monitoring for DeepSeek Harness: Crossref work records plus the verified filter=updates query, per-DOI status (retracted/concern/corrected/notice/clear/unknown), an append-only timeline with change detection, REP v1 evidence snapshots and SARIF output. clear means no registered notice, never proof of validity.
description.zh: 你引用的论文，后来有没有被撤稿或更正？Crossref 工作记录 + 已实测的 filter=updates:<doi> 查询、逐 DOI 状态、追加式时间线与 REP 证据。

description.en: Chinese-literature tooling for DeepSeek Harness without scraping: import RIS/EndNote-style or labeled (题名：/作者：/来源：) exports into stable records, format GB/T 7714-2015 (顺序编码制) or APA 7 citations (no invented fields), and run structural metadata validation (missing fields, implausible year, malformed DOI, duplicates). No CNKI login, no scraping, no CNKI API; exports are stored as REP evidence.
description.zh: 中文文献记录：导入你自己的导出文件，按 GB/T 7714 引用，检查元数据——全程不抓取 CNKI。读取 RIS/EndNote 风格或带标签的文本导出，分配稳定记录 id。

description.en: Systematic-review ledger for DeepSeek Harness: PRISMA 2020 protocol revisions, imported records, dual screening with explicit conflict adjudication, RoB 2 / ROBINS-I / GRADE assessments, derived PRISMA counts with integrity issues, and an export bundle (prisma.json/md, evidence-table.md, ledger.json) backed by a hash-chained append-only journal.
description.zh: 经得起复核的系统综述账本：只追加、双人筛选、PRISMA 2020、审计可验。记录方案、每条筛选决策、冲突裁决与 RoB/GRADE 评估，再推导 PRISMA 流程。

description.en: Recompute the statistics reported in a manuscript and flag self-inconsistent p values for DeepSeek Harness: APA-style t/F/chi-square/r/z parsing, two-tailed and upper-tail p values from zero-dependency distributions, CI-versus-p checks, exact character locators, Markdown and SARIF 2.1.0 output, and a REP v1 evidence record. Arithmetic, not accusation.
description.zh: 重算稿件报告的统计数据——并把对不上的那些标出来。这是算术，不是指控：每条 finding 都给出报告的统计量、它实际蕴含的 p 值，以及精确字符位置。

description.en: Read-only Zotero bridge for DeepSeek Harness: search and read a local Zotero library through the Local API or a copied zotero.sqlite, and register an item as REP evidence. No writes, no sync, no cloud.
description.zh: 只读 Zotero 桥：通过 Local API 或 sqlite 库副本检索 Zotero 条目，把选中条目转成 REP 记录；从不写 Zotero。

description.en: Check a customs declaration register row by row — you get a list of which row, which column, and what to fix; the verdict stays with the reviewer.
description.zh: 报关单证一致性核对（按公开的报关单填制规范核对单证间字段一致性，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Point out the numbers in a demurrage and detention ledger that do not add up — row by row, without pronouncing a verdict.
description.zh: 滞箱费台账核对（按免箱期与费率核对超期天数与金额的自洽性，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Check an export-control item register line by line — which row, which column, what is missing. Differences only, no verdict.
description.zh: 出口管制物项核对（按管制清单、最终用途与许可证核对台账齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Check a forecast-accuracy assessment register for completeness and assessment-charge arithmetic — you get a list of which row, which column, and what to fix; the verdict stays with the reviewer.
description.zh: 预测准确率考核核对（按准确率、门槛与考核单价核对考核费用的算术自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）

description.en: Reconcile carrier bills line by line against your ratecard — see what was overcharged, what was undercharged, and export the dispute file plus workpaper.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的纯本地运费对账插件：费率卡版本化、按「基础价 + 每公斤价 × 重量」再加燃油百分比逐票算应计金额、以分为单位记差额、导出 xlsx 底稿与争议 CSV——不联网、不调用模型、不上传。

description.en: Turn a product description into Top-3 HS candidates and list every missing one of the 12 classification elements.
description.zh: 把产品描述变成 Top-3 HS 候选编码，并把 12 项归类要素的缺项一次列清。

description.zh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话顶部任务面板（列表筛选、快速添加、完成、删除、截止日期、拖动排序）、十一个 ticktick_* 工具，以及基于官方 TickTick MCP 端点的插件设置卡。

description.en: Turn yes/no, which-one, and how-much into one local forward pass — probabilities come back to the host, and the state never leaves this machine.
description.zh: 把「是/否、选哪个、打几分」变成一次本地前向传播——概率回到 Host，state 不出这台机器。

description.en: Local-model (Ollama) integration for DeepSeek Harness: discover, pull, remove, and inspect local models, route requests to them by task type or keyword with automatic fallback to the cloud, and get a one-shot status overview via /ollama.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内运行本地模型：把 Ollama / LM Studio / 本地端点接成可直接替换的模型路由。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints, and rename tools over language servers, plus the editor action protocol (lsp.actions.*) that makes the plugin the IDE integration backend
description.zh: 把语言服务器的诊断、定义跳转、引用查找与修复暴露给 agent 的 IDE 集成插件。

description.en: MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client: /mcp command with health diagnostics and pipeline trial calls, a Settings MCP tab with server CRUD (append-only profile-patch fragments, approval-gated writes with automatic backups), a tool trial console over the official tool pipeline, connection status, reconnect counts and sanitized tool inventory, plus an optional Streamable HTTP probe.
description.zh: 只读 MCP 控制台：/mcp 命令带健康诊断与管道试调，设置页 MCP 标签管理服务器（写入需审批、自动备份），并可在官方工具管道上试调工具。

title.zh: 厂商参数映射与报文修复

description.en: Vendor parameter mapping and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: the /translate command maps temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system across 11 vendors, and the tools/post-execute repair layer (plus the fix_json tool) fixes broken JSON tool output with escape repair, trailing-comma removal, truncation closure, and required-field completion — never fabricating data

description.en: The session's inbound phone (WeChat bridge) attachment inbox: list what this conversation received and adopt one into the workspace
description.zh: 本会话的入站手机（微信桥）附件收件箱：列出这次对话真正收到的附件，并按需取进工作区

description.en: Multi-channel decision & remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: pushes any workspace's approval/question cards to IM channels (WeChat iLink first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
description.zh: 多渠道决策与远程控制桥：任何工作区的审批卡与提问卡镜像到 IM（微信 iLink、Telegram、飞书），用稳定的 #token 标识与 P{n} 编号，在聊天里经原生 pending 瀑布作答；发送者归属失败即拒，另带会话控制台与主动 reach_send。

description.en: Cost governance for DeepSeek Harness: aggregated token/cost metering per model, session and day, session/daily/monthly budget caps with threshold alerts (desktop notification + webhook) and alert/block/degrade over-limit policies, built-in carbon footprint estimation and per-model latency benchmarks, a Settings budget tab, and the /budget command
description.zh: 成本治理：按模型/会话/天汇总 token 与费用，预算上限配阈值告警与超限策略，估算碳足迹，做按模型的延迟基准，并提供 /budget 命令。

description.en: Read-only performance diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: session load (open/restore) timing, spill-hit counts, compaction count and trigger, context-injection volume (AGENTS.md/skills/tool-schema token share), and LLM cache hit rate — surfaced via the /fast command and the fast_report tool, persisted as reconstructable fast/* session events with async sampling off the model path.
description.zh: 只读性能诊断：会话加载/恢复耗时、落盘命中次数、压缩次数与触发原因、上下文注入量（AGENTS.md/技能/工具 schema 的 token 占比）与 LLM 缓存命中率，经 /fast 呈现。

description.en: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse observability exporter for DeepSeek Harness: turn/step/tool/LLM spans, token and cost metrics, and sanitized LLM prompt/completion capture from the session/event stream, with async batching, bounded offline buffering, and retry with backoff.
description.zh: 可观测性：请求追踪、遥测上报、日志缓冲与重试可见性。

description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control tools for DeepSeek Harness (Windows first): screen_shot, screen_read (accessibility tree + pixel description for text-only models), click/type/scroll/key, and app_list/app_launch — every mutating action gated by approval, never stealing foreground focus, with stale-observation rejection and process-identity checks

description.en: Unified static-image generation router for DeepSeek Harness: one image_generate tool with standard parameters, config-driven OpenAI-compatible engine routing (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, and any compatible endpoint) with health-aware fallback, durable workspace attachment results, per-session quota accounting, an in-conversation result card, and a Plugins settings panel that stores API keys as credential references.

description.en: Voice-first session loop for DeepSeek Harness: a composer microphone button with browser/local speech-to-text (Web Speech, FunASR, whisper.cpp), a speak tool for text-to-speech replies (browser, edge-tts, piper), event announcements with mute, and speak-to-interrupt.

description.en: Inspect DOCX structure, verify a part-wise identical roundtrip, and diff two versions paragraph by paragraph — entirely local, no network.

description.en: Pre-submission checklist for DeepSeek Harness: manuscript structure and declaration statements, keyword-based coverage of starter CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA items with locators and advice, and a submission-pack scan (manuscript, cover letter, numbered figures with gap detection, tables, supplements, declarations) with JSON/Markdown reports. A checklist, not a compliance verdict.

description.en: Turn a punch-clock CSV into per-employee daily hours, overtime, over-limit days, missing punches and short breaks, then roll the month up and export a reconciliation CSV.

title.zh: Famling · 汀岚 / 布偶猫 / 金毛

description.en: Shows a pixel mini pet (Tinglan, Ragdoll cat, Golden Retriever) below the DSH account area with no permanent buttons besides the character; right-click the pet (or press Shift+F10 / ContextMenu) to open a restrained hierarchical menu (chat / play / content & characters / settings / more), with submenu pages and full keyboard navigation. A role IS its theme bundle, so the content center is organized as Roles / Customize / Packs / Market; a unified settings popup centralizes every adjustable item and can enable an optional menu button (off by default). Content packs use the reserved v3 pure-data contract with a mandatory research-only declaration; no network, no script execution. Chat text goes through the DSH Host to the model provider configured in DSH (disclosed in the chat panel and settings; never send passwords, private data or client material); crisis keywords are short-circuited locally in the Host with 12356/110/120 and professional-service resources, and settings can turn AI chat off and clear all local settings/consent (withdrawal). Four-level scaling (0.10.4): Common has an overall scale (everything together), independent UI + text / image axes can decouple and follow the overall scale again in one click, and the folded advanced group has per-component scaling that inherits UI + text by default. It only writes this widget's inline styles, never the DSH global theme; persisted under dsh-famling/scale with a one-time migration of the legacy absolute multipliers, the bubble is capped at 240px, menus/panels are fitted to the viewport after scaling, and native range inputs stay keyboard operable. 0.10.6 low disturbance: a new Low disturbance settings group with quiet hours (on by default 22:00-08:00; automatic bubbles and random micro actions are 0 while taps and chat replies still answer; editable or off), an animation preference (follow the system prefers-reduced-motion / allow / reduce motion, with the legacy motion boolean migrated), and temporary hide (1 hour / until tomorrow, persisted in dsh-famling/hidden-until with a single Show restore control and automatic restore); automatic micro actions are now >=60s apart; the input/consent/usage dialogs moved to the lazy client.content.js chunk while the first-screen budget stays within 96 KiB. 0.10.10 versioned consent: TTS/ASR consent is stored as per-kind declaration version, zh+en declaration SHA-256, acceptedAt and withdrawn; a version/hash mismatch re-prompts, the legacy boolean v1 is migrated to withdrawn records, and settings can withdraw it separately. 0.10.11 cross-repo sync: the cat is now a same-palette blue-bicolor Ragdoll (16 palette hexes unchanged, palette id cat-ragdoll-anim@0.1, white silky long coat with cool blue-grey points); cat UI copy is unified as Ragdoll, the wash line now reads long hair, the cat/dog renderer labels are synced, and the cat animation chunk is re-embedded. 0.10.12 host-adaptive appearance: the cat/dog default backgrounds are now transparent (bubble/panel themes stay), the right-click menu no longer uses role-theme hard-coded colours and instead reads DSH host theme variables with light-dark() fallbacks that follow day/night, the buttonBase fallbacks match day/night, and the widget root inherits the host color-scheme.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左下角账号信息下方显示像素小桌宠（汀岚 / 布偶猫 / 金毛），默认不显示角色以外任何按钮；右键角色或按 Shift+F10 / ContextMenu 打开分级菜单（聊两句 / 互动 / 内容与角色 / 设置 / 更多）；角色就是主题，内容中心一级分类为角色、自定义、内容包、市场，一键切换角色会同时应用声音策略、对话模式与外观（气泡 / 面板 / 背景 / 字体）；统一设置弹窗集中所有可调项，并可开启「显示菜单按钮」（默认关闭）；内容包与远程市场接口已预留（v3 纯数据契约，强制研究用途声明），不联网、不执行脚本；聊天文本经 DSH Host 发给用户在 DSH 中配置的模型供应商（输入面板与设置明示，勿发密码/隐私/客户资料），聊天危机关键词在 Host 本地短路并返回 12356/110/120 与专业机构资源，设置内可关闭 AI 聊天并一键清除本机设置/同意（撤回）。 四层缩放（0.10.4）：常用「整体缩放」= 所有内容一并缩放，独立轴「UI + 文本 / 图像」可单独解耦并一键跟随整体，高级折叠「组件缩放」默认继承 UI + 文本；只作用于本插件 widget 的内联样式，不改 DSH 全局主题；持久化 dsh-famling/scale 并一次性迁移旧绝对倍率，气泡 ≤ 240px 不溢出、菜单/面板按缩放夹取、原生 range 键盘可达。 0.10.6 低打扰：设置弹窗新增「低打扰」分组——安静时段（默认 22:00–08:00 开启，时段内自动气泡/随机微动作=0，点击与聊天回复仍可用，可改时段或关闭）、动画偏好（跟随系统 prefers-reduced-motion / 允许动画 / 减少动态，旧 motion 布尔迁移）、暂时隐藏（1 小时/到明天，持久化到 dsh-famling/hidden-until，只留一个「显示」恢复控件，到点自动恢复）；自动微动作间隔提高到 ≥60 秒；输入/同意/使用限制弹窗移入懒加载 client.content.js，首屏预算保持 96 KiB 内。 0.10.10 版本化同意：TTS/ASR 同意逐项保存声明版本、zh+en 声明 SHA-256、acceptedAt 与 withdrawn，版本/哈希不符即重弹；旧布尔 v1 一次性迁移为 withdrawn 记录，设置内可单独撤回。 0.10.11 跨仓同步：猫改为同配色蓝重点双色布偶猫（16 个 palette hex 不变，palette id `cat-ragdoll-anim@0.1`，白底丝滑长毛 + 冷灰蓝重点），猫 UI 文案统一为「布偶猫」、洗脸台词改为「长毛不好梳」，猫/狗渲染器标签同步，插件重新嵌入 cat 动画 chunk。 0.10.12 宿主自适应外观：猫/狗默认背景改为透明（气泡/面板主题保留），右键菜单不再使用角色主题硬编码配色，改用 DSH 宿主主题变量 + light-dark() 回退并随昼夜切换，buttonBase 回退同步 day/night，widget 根 color-scheme 继承宿主。
